certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — IFRS 13 Fair Value Measurement

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the definition of fair value and the concept of an exit price
Identify the principal or most advantageous market and market participants
Apply the fair value hierarchy and classify inputs across its three levels
Select an appropriate valuation technique for an asset or liability
Apply highest-and-best-use and other concepts for non-financial assets
Prepare the disclosures that explain fair value measurements

integrative_case: A fund must fair-value listed shares, an over-the-counter derivative, an unquoted private holding valued with a model, and a parcel of development land; identify the markets and participants, place each measurement in the fair value hierarchy, select valuation techniques, apply highest-and-best-use to the land, and draft the fair value disclosures.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
